TARGET MASTER
CR 12

XP 19,200
Human marksman 12
CE Medium humanoid (human, psionic)
Init +6; Senses Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 14, flat-footed 21 (+2 Dex, +2 deflection, +1 natural, +8 armor); +3 vs. ranged attacks
hp 88 (12d10+12+6)
Fort +7, Ref +12, Will +13
Defensive Abilities cover fire, disengage, evade arrows +3

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee +2 dagger +22/+17/+12 (1d4+15 P or S, 19–20/×2)
Ranged +2 dagger +25/+20/+15 (1d4+15 P or S, 19–20/×2, range incr. 20 ft.)
Special Attacks favored weapon +3 (thrown), sniper stye abilities (augmented shot, second chance [6/day], unstoppable force), sniper stye mantra, sniper stye technique, wind reader (15/day)
Marksman Powers Known (ML 12th, concentration +15)

Power points—58/day, max. 12/use
0-level—trick shot
1st-level (1pp)—metaphysical weapon (A), offensive prescience (A)
2nd-level (3pp)—blinding shot (A), ephemeral bolt (A), knockdown
3rd-level (5pp)—flexible trajectory (A), physical acceleration (A)

STATISTICS

Str 25 (+7), Dex 14 (+2), Con 12 (+1), Int 10 (+0), Wis 16 (+3), Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +12; CMB +14; CMD 28
Feats Deadly Aim, Deep Focus, Improved Initiative, Point-Blank Shot (B), Psionic Body, Psionic Shot, Quick Draw, Startoss Comet, Startoss Shower, Startoss Style, Weapon Focus (dagger)
Skills Acrobatics +21 (+30 to jump), Autohypnosis +18, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +25
Languages Common
SQ marksman combat style (sniper style), style skill +4 (Stealth)
Gear +3 chain shirt, (3) +2 daggers, amulet of natural armor +1, boots of striding and springing, greater belt of mighty hurling, cloak of resistance +2, headband of inspiring wisdom +2, ring of protection +2, 50 gp
